title: Payments applied before the release are not checked again
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use the production test account.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, created on production before the release.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced and paid by customer A on production before the release.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The payment applied before the release is still applied, with its amount unchanged.
  • No refusal or warning shows about it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12312 (Story 10, Receivables follow the Bill To)

  • S10-N3: “Payments and credits applied before this release are not re-checked.”
  • Key Decisions: “A payment settles only invoices its own customer owes. Enforced for new payments only; existing applications are left as they are.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - needs records made on production before the release reaches production; run on production after the release
